posts.cooked: When I finally did the Redirection acheivement some time ago I believe I setup the following.   Blade Battalion hit Tachyon who was highest redirected by Synaptic Interruption to the lowest health hero, which got redirected by Wraith’s smoke bombs, which got redirected to Scholar with Alchemial Redirection, which got redirected to Legacy with Lead from the Front, and finally sent to Stealth Bot.

posts.name: broccoli
posts.cooked: Yeah, your best bets definitely revolve around Lead from the Front, Synaptic Interruption, Stealth Bot, and Smoke Bombs.  I think in mine I managed to redirect to Tachyon twice using 2 different Synaptic Interruptions.  Argent Adept helps as well, since with Scherzo of Frost and Flame, you can adjust people's hps to be exactly where you need them.  In particular, if everyone is at the same hp, they're all the highest and lowest for smoke bombs.

posts.name: FrivYeti
posts.cooked:
I believe I got the redirects by taking Legacy, Wraith, the Scholar, the Naturalist, and Fanatic out to play, Legacy, Naturalist, and Scholar got their respective "redirect to me"s out, Wraith played Smoke Bombs, and Fanatic shot herself in the face a bunch and then hit someone to redirect all their damage to her. Then someone attacked Legacy, which redirected to Fanatic, which redirected through Smoke Bombs to the Scholar, which redirected to Legacy, which redirected to the Naturalist, which redirected back to the Scholar.

(Also good choice - Unity. Keep the Stealth Bot out as the only bot, and use smoke bombs, and you've got two redirects to start.)
